part1.text: Proficient in Linux and Windows operating systems, and comfortable using Bash and Powershell for daily tasks.

part2.text: Familiar with Shell, Python, and Perl languages, with some understanding of Golang and JavaScript. Able to use automation scripts to solve daily work problems.

part3.text: Possesses some knowledge of Cloud Native technology, and is proficient in Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm tools.

part4.text: Understands virtualization technology and is familiar with tools such as VMware, VirtualBox, and Vagrant.

part5.text: Proficient in using Git, GitHub, and other version control tools, as well as Jenkins and GitHub Actions for CI/CD.

part6.text: Familiar with monitoring tools like Prometheus and Grafana.

part7.text: Proficient in TCP/IP networking protocols and capable of analyzing and solving network-related issues.

part8.text: Familiar with React and other related technologies, with some understanding of Frontend Development.
